overview: 本期共收录 12 篇论文。研究方向主要集中在金融经济学（8 篇）、银行与信贷（1 篇）、风险管理与衍生品（1 篇）。方法上以蒙特卡洛模拟、数值模拟为主。来源分布：arXiv（7 篇）、Semantic Scholar（2 篇）、NBER（2 篇）。其中 2 篇命中顶级期刊白名单。

papers.title: Public debt shocks and the interest-growth differential: a two-step CCE procedure with Monte Carlo evidence
papers.abstract:
Abstract
                  This study proposes a two-step heterogeneous CCE procedure to estimate non-systematic variation in public debt and its effects on the interest-growth differential. We consider two dynamic DGPs that satisfy the rank condition and assume that the set of unobserved common factors is characterized by mixed orders of integration. The empirical results indicate that unanticipated variations in public debt exert positive average effects on the interest-growth differential. However, the distribution of the unit-specific estimated coefficients suggests that the effects are markedly heterogeneous across countries. The Monte Carlo experiments suggest that the CCE estimators employed in this paper exhibit good finite-sample properties in the proposed dynamic heterogeneous framework, even under unusual and complex time-series properties of the latent stochastic factors.
papers.summary_zh:
【金融经济学】摘要  
本研究提出了一种两步异质性CCE（Common Cointegration Estimation）方法，用于估计公共债务的非系统性波动及其对利率-增长差（interest-growth differential）的影响。我们考虑了两个满足秩条件的动态广义向量自回归（DGPs）模型，并假设未观测到的共同因子具有混合阶数的整合特性。实证结果表明，公共债务的意外变动对利率-增长差具有正向的平均影响；然而，各国特定系数分布的差异表明这种影响存在显著异质性。蒙特卡洛实验表明，即使在潜在随机因子具有异常和复杂的时间序列特性下，本文所采用的CCE估计量在所提出的动态异质性框架中仍具备良好的有限样本性质。。研究方法：蒙特卡洛模拟、实验方法、随机过程。

papers.title: The Measurement Revolution? Credible Measurement and Inference in the Age of AI
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is transforming measurement in economics. AI models convert unstructured data, such as text and images, into structured variables at low cost, making previously prohibitive measurement feasible at scale. This shifts the bottleneck from finding any scalable measure of a phenomenon to choosing among many plausible ones, which may support different empirical conclusions. This review provides guidance for navigating that shift. We describe three stages at which AI enters the measurement pipeline---discovery, construct definition, and observation---and what each demands of researchers. We argue that credible inference with AI-generated variables requires appropriately designed validation: anchoring measurement to explicit criteria, rather than informal claims that a proxy is reasonable. We then examine how validation samples support valid inference even when AI predictions are arbitrarily biased, and what can be done when a random validation sample is unavailable.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】人工智能（AI）正在改变经济学中的测量方法。AI模型能够以较低的成本将文本、图像等非结构化数据转化为结构化变量，从而使以前难以大规模实施的测量变得可行。这改变了研究中的瓶颈：从“能否找到某种可扩展的测量方法”转变为“在众多可能的测量方法中选择哪种方法”，因为不同的测量方法可能会得出不同的实证结论。本文为应对这一变化提供了指导。我们阐述了AI在测量流程中参与的三个阶段——数据发现、变量构建与观测——以及每个阶段对研究人员的具体要求。我们认为，要利用AI生成的变量进行可靠的推断，必须进行恰当的验证：将测量结果与明确的标准相对照，而不仅仅是基于非正式的假设来判断某个代理变量是否合理。接下来，我们探讨了即使在AI预测存在任意偏差的情况下，验证样本如何仍能支持有效的推断；同时，也分析了在无法获取随机验证样本时可以采取的应对措施。。

papers.title: Testing selection on observables in parametric models with refreshment samples
papers.abstract: In panels with sample selection (that may occur due to attrition, nonresponse, etc.), the assumption of selection on observables (missing at random, MAR) is commonly imposed despite often being implausible. However, this assumption becomes testable when a refreshment sample is available. We develop a statistical test of MAR based on a distance between two estimated distributions: one obtained using the standard inverse probability weighting (IPW) that is valid under MAR and the other obtained using an alternative weighting that is valid under a weaker assumption of additive nonignorability of Hirano et al. (2001). This test implicitly compares the distribution of the IPW-weighted sample in the attrition period with the distribution of the refreshment sample, which coincide if the MAR assumption holds. We establish that, when the input distributions are parametric, our test statistic converges to the generalized chi-squared distribution under the null of MAR. This limit distribution can be estimated using the recursive formulas derived by Franguridi et al. (2026). We illustrate the performance of our test in Monte Carlo simulations. Finally, we apply our test to an empirical example using a subsample of the Understanding America Study (UAS) dataset.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】在存在样本选择问题的研究中（样本选择可能由于退出、无响应等原因而发生），尽管这一假设往往并不成立，但人们仍通常会假设选择过程是依据可观测变量进行的（即“缺失数据随机发生”（Missing At Random, MAR））。然而，当有补充样本可用时，这一假设便变得可以被检验。我们基于两个估计分布之间的距离开发了一种检验MAR的统计方法：其中一个分布是使用标准的逆概率加权（Inverse Probability Weighting, IPW）方法得到的，该方法在MAR假设下是有效的；另一个分布则是使用Hirano等人（2001年）提出的、基于较弱假设（即数据的可加性非忽略性）的加权方法得到的。该检验隐含地将退出期中经过IPW加权处理的样本分布与补充样本的分布进行比较；如果MAR假设成立，这两种分布应当是一致的。我们证明了：当输入分布满足参数化条件时，在MAR假设为真的情况下，我们的检验统计量会收敛到广义卡方分布（generalized chi-squared distribution）。这种极限分布可以通过Franguridi等人（2026年）推导出的递归公式来估计。我们通过蒙特卡洛...。研究方法：蒙特卡洛模拟、数值模拟。

papers.title: The Influence of Good Corporate Governance, Risk, Profitability, Capitalization, Leverage, and Liquidity on Company Value in the Banking Industry Sector Listed on the Indonesia Stock Exchange in 2022-2025
papers.venue: Dinasti International Journal of Economics, Finance & Accounting
papers.abstract: This study examines the effect of Good Corporate Governance (GCG), risk, profitability, capital adequacy, leverage, and liquidity on firm value in banking companies listed on the Indonesia Stock Exchange during 2022–2025. Firm value is measured using Price to Book Value (PBV), while GCG, risk, profitability, capital adequacy, leverage, and liquidity are proxied by CGPI, NPL, ROA, CAR, DAR, and LDR, respectively. This quantitative study uses secondary data from annual reports, with samples selected through purposive sampling. The data were analyzed using multiple linear regression with SPSS. The results show that profitability, capital adequacy, and leverage have a positive and significant effect on firm value, whereas GCG, risk, and liquidity have no significant effect. These findings indicate that investors place greater emphasis on profitability, capital strength, and debt management in assessing firm value.
papers.summary_zh: 【银行与信贷】本研究考察了良好公司治理（Good Corporate Governance, GCG）、风险、盈利能力、资本充足率、杠杆率和流动性对2022至2025年间在印度尼西亚证券交易所上市的银行业公司市值的影响。市值通过市净率（Price to Book Value, PBV）来衡量，而良好公司治理、风险、盈利能力、资本充足率、杠杆率和流动性分别通过CGPI、NPL、ROA、CAR、DAR和LDR等指标进行代理。该定量研究使用了年度报告中的二手数据，并通过目的性抽样方法选取样本。数据分析采用SPSS软件进行多元线性回归分析。研究结果表明，盈利能力、资本充足率和杠杆率对市值具有正向且显著的影响，而良好公司治理、风险和流动性则没有显著影响。这些发现表明，在评估公司市值时，投资者更重视盈利能力、资本实力和债务管理。。研究方法：回归分析。

papers.title: Private Clinic Integration through Hybrid Models within Government Hospitals: A Systematic Review of Funding Efficiency and Quality-of-Care Outcomes with Policy Implications for Oman
papers.venue: Journal of Economics, Finance and Accounting Studies
papers.abstract: As artificial intelligence and adjacent technologies take on a larger role in private markets, the ability to evaluate high-growth technology firms has become increasingly important for private-equity investors. We examine whether technology-focused PE sponsors differ from generalist sponsors in the sectors they enter, the prices they pay, the way they structure acquisitions, and the valuation outcomes that follow. Using a deal-level sample of 808 technology-unicorn acquisitions announced between 2010 and 2024, we combine Crunchbase transaction data with sector-level EV/EBITDA benchmarks from NYU Stern. Our primary analysis focuses on 601 acquisitions involving U.S.-based PE sponsors and compares specialist and generalist acquisition behavior across several dimensions. We find that technology-focused sponsors acquire in sectors with EV/EBITDA benchmarks 4.10 points higher than those associated with generalists, a difference of approximately 8.87% in logarithmic terms. Yet their preference for more highly valued sectors does not translate into higher relative prices at the company level: specialist-sponsored transactions are associated with substantially lower price-to-revenue multiples at entry. Specialists also structure acquisitions differently. Compared with all-cash transactions, technology-focused sponsors show a 33.6% higher relative likelihood of using mixed cash-and-stock consideration and a 71.6% higher relative likelihood of using pure stock. The differences extend beyond the acquisition itself. Within 12 months, acquisitions involving technology-focused sponsors have estimated odds of exceeding their matched sector EV/EBITDA benchmark that are 5.47 times those of acquisitions involving generalists, although this result is significant at the 10% level. These patterns are less uniform outside the United States, where the domestic relationship between specialization and sector selection is no longer statistically detectable across 207 international acquisitions. Taken together, the evidence suggests that specialization is reflected not simply in what PE sponsors acquire, but in the markets they enter, the relative prices they pay, the way they structure transactions, and the valuation outcomes that follow.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】随着人工智能及相关技术在私营市场中的地位日益重要，评估高增长科技企业的能力对私募股权投资者来说变得愈发关键。我们研究了专注于科技领域的私募股权（PE）投资机构与综合性投资机构在投资领域、支付价格、收购方式以及后续估值结果方面的差异。通过分析2010年至2024年间宣布的808起科技独角兽企业收购案例，我们将Crunchbase的交易数据与纽约大学斯特恩商学院提供的行业层面EV/EBITDA（企业价值与息税折旧摊销前利润比率）基准数据进行结合。主要研究聚焦于601起由美国私募股权机构参与的收购案例，并从多个维度比较了专业型与综合性投资机构的收购行为。研究发现，专注于科技领域的投资机构更倾向于投资EV/EBITDA比率高于行业平均水平的行业——这一差异在对数意义上约为8.87%。然而，他们对高估值行业的偏好并未体现在企业层面的更高收购价格上：专业型投资机构参与的收购在交易初期的市盈率明显较低。此外，这两类投资机构在收购结构上也存在差异：与纯现金交易相比，专注于科技领域的投资机构采用现金加股票混合支付方式的概率高出33.6%，采用纯股票支付方式的概率高出71.6%。这些差异不仅体现在收...。

papers.title: Instrument Hacking
papers.abstract: In instrumental-variable (IV) studies, researchers often evaluate multiple candidate instruments and selectively report the specification with the most favorable first- or second-stage statistics. We show that this form of instrument selection (“instrument-hacking”) induces median bias in IV estimators toward the OLS estimand, undermining the rationale for using IV. When all candidate instruments have the same true strength, median bias increases monotonically with the number of available instruments. More generally, when candidate instruments differ in true strength, monotonicity need not hold because increasing the number of instruments can lead researchers to select genuinely stronger instruments. Nonetheless, in simulations calibrated to the empirical distribution of instrument strengths in the IV literature, median bias increases monotonically with the number of available instruments. Furthermore, it is substantial in magnitude, even when only a few instruments are available.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】在工具变量（IV）研究中，研究人员通常会评估多个候选工具变量，并选择那些在第一阶段或第二阶段统计量上表现最佳的模型进行报告。我们发现，这种工具变量的选择方式（即所谓的“工具变量操纵”）会导致IV估计量产生向普通最小二乘（OLS）估计量偏倚的倾向，从而削弱了使用IV方法的合理性。当所有候选工具变量的真实效应强度相同时，随着可用工具变量数量的增加，这种偏倚会呈单调递增趋势。更一般地，当候选工具变量的真实效应强度存在差异时，这种单调性并不一定成立，因为增加工具变量的数量可能会使研究人员选择到效应强度更强的工具变量。然而，在根据IV文献中工具变量真实效应强度的分布特征进行模拟的情况下，即使只有少数工具变量可用，这种偏倚仍然会随着工具变量数量的增加而持续增大，且其幅度相当显著。。研究方法：数值模拟、模型校准。

papers.title: The Yeoman's Portfolio: Measuring Historical Risk Preferences Using Crop Choice
papers.abstract: We design a method for measuring the risk preferences of agents in the deep past. The method combines a structural model of crop choice as a portfolio allocation with machine-learning prediction of expected crop returns, using historic agronomic and climate data. We estimate county-level risk preferences for the United States and farmer-level preferences in Kansas from 1889 to 1929. More risk averse farmers leveraged less, were less likely to purchase novel WWI Liberty Bonds, and were more likely to participate in local risk-sharing institutions. We show that higher risk aversion predicts slower tractor adoption and farm mechanization during the 1920s.
papers.summary_zh: 【风险管理与衍生品】我们设计了一种方法，用于测量远古时期代理人（即当时的农民）的风险偏好。该方法将作物选择的结构模型（视为一种投资组合配置）与机器学习技术相结合，利用历史上的农业数据和气候数据来预测作物的预期收益。我们估算了1889年至1929年间美国各州的风险偏好情况，以及堪萨斯州农民个体的风险偏好。风险厌恶程度较高的农民更倾向于减少耕作面积，不太可能购买一战期间发行的“自由债券”，并且更有可能参与当地的风险共担机制。研究结果表明，在20世纪20年代，较高的风险厌恶程度会延缓拖拉机的普及和农业机械化进程。。研究方法：结构模型。

papers.title: Systematic Bias in Green Patent Classification: Silent Green and False Green
papers.abstract: Green-patent indicators built on Cooperative Patent Classification Y02 tags are widely used in research, policy, and investment, yet their construct validity has not been audited at corpus scale. We assess whether Y02 is systematically biased and whether that bias may reinforce the ESG innovation disconnect. We introduce an Error-as-Signal framework that treats disagreement between an administrative label and an independent model as diagnostic evidence of measurement error. Screening 9,075,421 USPTO granted patents (1962-2024) with a fine-tuned domain model against Y02 yields 517,772 disagreements. Two independent open-weight large language models then judge by consensus whether each flagged invention has a direct climate-mitigation or adaptation function. We identify 180,384 administrative Type I errors (False Green), concentrated in digital data processing, wireless networks, digital communications, and semiconductors, and 29,465 Type II errors (Silent Green), concentrated in separation processes, catalysis, exhaust control, heat pumps, power systems, and batteries. Correcting consensus-attributed errors reduces the measured green-patent population by 25.5% (592,387 to 441,468 patents; sensitivity bounds 390,540-508,126), with ICT energy efficiency (Y02D) falling 67.6%. Omission follows an inverted-U relationship with technological atypicality, making complex and unconventional inventions especially likely to go unlabelled. Event tests show no discrete jump in misclassification when green classification became salient and only a small rise in green framing after the 2013 CPC launch. The bias primarily reflects classification capacity rather than applicant strategy and structurally under-recognizes heavy industry.
papers.summary_zh: 【行为金融】基于合作专利分类（Cooperative Patent Classification, CPC）Y02标签构建的绿色专利指标在研究、政策和投资领域被广泛使用，但其构建有效性尚未在大规模语料库中进行过验证。我们评估了Y02标签是否存在系统性偏差，以及这种偏差是否可能加剧环境、社会和治理（ESG）创新之间的脱节。我们提出了一种“错误即信号”（Error-as-Signal）框架，将行政标签与独立模型之间的分歧视为测量误差的诊断证据。通过对1962年至2024年间美国专利商标局（USPTO）授予的9,075,421项专利使用经过微调的领域模型进行筛查，发现了517,772处标签不一致的情况。随后，两个独立的开放式语言模型通过共识判断每项被标记的发明是否具有直接的气候缓解或适应功能。研究结果发现：存在180,384例属于I类错误（虚假绿色专利），主要集中在数字数据处理、无线网络、数字通信和半导体领域；另有29,465例属于II类错误（隐性绿色专利），主要集中在分离工艺、催化技术、尾气控制、热泵、电力系统和电池领域。纠正这些被共识认定为错误的专利后，绿色专利的数量减少了25.5%（从592...。研究方法：大语言模型。

papers.title: The Axiomatic Trader: Latent Regularity, Information Budgets, and the Canonical Form of a Quantitative Investment System
papers.abstract: Systematic trading rests on one article of faith: that regularities found in the past persist. We state it as a time-invariant mechanism driven by an unobserved latent state, and show that it leaves a researcher five constants to declare --- the recurrence bound $Lambda$ at a block length $b$, the invariance defect $epsilon_0$ of the representation it is declared of, the coherence times $ell_i$ of the state's coordinates, the signal ceiling $rho$ and the fraction $kappa$ of it contingent on the regime --- after which the architecture of a correct quantitative investment system is nearly forced.
papers.summary_zh: 【国际贸易】系统性交易基于一个核心信念：过去发现的规律性会持续存在。我们将这一机制描述为一个不受时间影响的、由某种未被观测到的潜在状态所驱动的过程，并指出在这一过程中，研究者需要确定五个关键参数——块长度为$b$时的重复性界限$\Lambda$、所采用表示方法的不变性缺陷$\epsilon_0$、状态坐标的相干时间$ell_i$、信号上限$\rho$，以及该机制所依赖的特定情境下的比例$kappa$。一旦这些参数确定，一个正确的量化投资系统的架构几乎就随之确立。。

papers.title: Optimal Grading: A Unified Approach
papers.abstract: We develop a unified approach to optimal grading in an all-pay contest in which a designer assigns a fixed vector of heterogeneous prizes to maximize expected total effort. The approach covers two information regimes and identifies a common principle: iron locally misordered incentive returns and assign prizes assortatively across the resulting grades. Under rank-only grading, assignments depend only on ordinal ranks. Ironing cumulative rank coefficients---via the least concave majorant or the pool-adjacent-violators algorithm---determines which adjacent ranks are pooled and which prizes are randomized within each grade. Under performance-contingent grading, assignments may depend on numerical effort. The optimum irons virtual ability, forms endogenous type grades, and assigns prize blocks assortatively across grades. A failing grade below a minimum passing effort and a collection of effort brackets implement the direct optimum while preserving full prize assignment.
papers.summary_zh:
【金融经济学】我们提出了一种统一的优化评分方法，适用于所有参与者都需要付费的竞赛场景。在这种竞赛中，设计者会分配一组固定的、具有差异性的奖励，以最大化参与者的总体努力水平。该方法涵盖了两种信息处理方式，并揭示了一个共同原则：无论信息如何，都应确保奖励与参与者的实际表现相匹配。具体而言：

1. 在仅依据排名进行评分的情况下，奖励的分配完全基于参与者的排名顺序。通过使用“最小凹函数上界法”或“池相邻违规者算法”来调整累积排名系数，可以确定哪些相邻的排名应被合并，以及每个排名组内的奖励应如何随机分配。
2. 在根据表现来评分的情况下，奖励的分配可能会考虑参与者的实际付出努力程度。这种方法能够“熨平”虚拟能力（即排名与实际能力之间的差异），从而形成内生的类型等级，并将奖励按照一定的规则在各个等级之间进行分配。

该方法确保了即使存在评分失误（如排名顺序错误），也能实现最优的奖励分配方案。同时，通过设定最低通过标准及相应的努力区间，可以在保持完整奖励分配机制的前提下，确保评分结果的合理性。。研究方法：随机实验。

papers.title: KellyBoost: Growth-Optimal Portfolio Construction with Gradient-Boosted Trees
papers.abstract: KellyBoost is a single multi-output XGBoost model whose softmax output is the portfolio: with y the vector of per-asset holding-period returns, the training loss is - log(1 + w y), the negative log growth rate, so the fitted model is the growth-optimal (Kelly) allocation conditioned on the features. The objective is exact rather than a surrogate: we derive the gradient, the analytic diagonal Hessian and the full Hessian in closed form, verify them by finite differences, and ship a dependency-free reference engine.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】KellyBoost是一个单输出的多输出XGBoost模型，其softmax输出代表投资组合的配置方案。其中，y表示每项资产在持有期内的回报向量；训练损失函数为-log(1 + wy)，即负对数增长率。因此，该模型能够根据输入特征生成最优增长（Kelly）配置方案。我们的目标是最优解本身，而非近似解：我们推导出了模型的梯度、解析形式的对角Hessian矩阵以及完整的Hessian矩阵，并通过有限差分方法对其准确性进行了验证。最终，我们提供了一个不依赖于任何外部库的独立参考实现。。研究方法：XGBoost。

papers.title: Culture and constitutional compliance
papers.abstract: Constitutions as the formal foundation of a country's legal and political system have important economic and political effects. Yet, we still know little about why constitutions set effective constraints on politicians in some societies, while being largely disregarded in others. Here, we ask if national culture matters for constitutional compliance. We study a cross-section of 115 countries, making use of novel indicators of constitutional compliance. We find that societies with a more individualistic population exhibit higher levels of compliance. These results are robust and extend to instrumental variables estimations. They imply a novel transmission channel from cultural traits to long-term economic development: individualistic national culture increases the credibility of constitutional self-commitments. Our analysis also supports the more general idea that the effects of formal institutions depend on the informal institutional environment in which they are embedded. Regarding religion, our results are consistent with past research that attributes the lack of development in the modern Muslim world to deficient institutional quality.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】宪法作为国家法律和政治体系的正式基础，具有重要的经济和政治影响。然而，我们对于为何在某些社会中宪法能够对政治家产生有效的约束作用，而在其他社会中却几乎被忽视，仍知之甚少。在这里，我们探讨了国家文化是否对宪法的遵守程度具有影响。我们研究了115个国家的样本数据，并采用了新的宪法遵守度衡量指标。研究发现，具有更个人主义倾向的社会其宪法遵守程度更高。这些结果具有稳健性，并且在引入工具变量进行估计后依然成立。这表明从文化特征到长期经济发展的过程中存在一种新的传导机制：个人主义的国家文化增强了人们对宪法承诺的可信度。我们的分析还支持了一个更为普遍的观点，即正式制度的作用取决于其所所处的非正式制度环境。在宗教方面，我们的研究结果与以往的研究一致，这些研究将现代穆斯林世界的发展滞后归因于制度质量的不足。。研究方法：工具变量、横截面分析。
